state.feed: Lichess public game streams, which Lichess holds back by a few seconds (longer in slower games)

baselines.label: the player to move blunders within their next three moves
baselines.selection: trained on train, hyper-parameters chosen by validation AUC, every number below is on test
baselines.bootstrap: 1,000 resamples of whole games, percentile 95% interval

call_threshold.meaning: the 90th percentile of validation scores; the live watcher calls a blunder at or above it

tslm-clocks+engine-before-padding-fix.answers_after: the model's own description of the series
tslm-clocks+engine-before-padding-fix.note: first run, before the padding fix: the series labels and the question never reached the model

tslm-clocks+engine.answers_after: the model's own description of the series
